lead: Every line item read off the photo, sorted into categories, and totalled by the month it was actually bought in.

shoot.title: Shoot it
shoot.text: One photo, or several overlapping ones for a long receipt.

check.title: Check what we read
check.text: Anything unclear is flagged for you rather than quietly guessed.

see.title: See where it went
see.text: Month-to-date spend by category, against a limit you set.

privacy: Receipt photos and their extracted data are encrypted at rest and visible only to you.
